goggle.definition: v. look with amazement; look stupidly
goggle.translation:
n. 眼睛瞪视, 护目镜
a. 突出的, 瞪眼的
vi. 瞪眼看, 眼珠转动
vt. 使瞪眼, 使眼珠转动

goggle box.translation:
n. 〈英俚〉电视机
[网络] 英俚电视机

goggle-eye.definition: n. of Atlantic coastal waters; commonly used for bait
goggle-eye.translation: n. 不掺水的劣等威士忌酒; [复数]-eyes, eye 弹突鱼类

goggle-eyed.definition: s with eyes or mouth open in surprise
goggle-eyed.translation: a. 突眼的, 眼珠突出的

goggle-eyes.translation: (goggle-eye 的复数) n. 不掺水的劣等威士忌酒; [复数]-eyes, eye 弹突鱼类

goggled.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Goggle
a. Prominent; staring, as the eye.
goggled.translation:
a. 戴护目镜的
v. 睁大眼睛瞪视, （惊讶的）转动眼珠( goggle的过去式和过去分词 )

goggleeyed.translation: a. 瞪眼的, 眼珠突出的, 转动眼睛的

goggler.definition:
n. A carangoid oceanic fish (Trachurops crumenophthalmus),
   having very large and prominent eyes; -- called also goggle-eye,
   big-eyed scad, and cicharra.
goggler.translation: n. 瞪大眼的人, 转动眼珠的人; 用鱼叉捕鱼的人

goggles.definition: n. tight-fitting spectacles worn to protect the eyes

n. 护目镜, 风镜
[化] 防护镜; 防护眼镜; 护目镜; 眼罩

goggling.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Goggle
goggling.translation: v. 睁大眼睛瞪视, （惊讶的）转动眼珠( goggle的现在分词 )

gogh.definition: n Dutch Post-impressionist painter noted for his use of color (1853-1890)
